challenges.title: Seasonal drinking-water failure in Latehar hamlets
challenges.description: Three hamlets report recurring borewell failure in summer. Hand pumps remain unusable for days because repair teams and spare parts arrive late. Mobile data connectivity is intermittent.
challenges.aiSummary: Seasonal drinking-water access is disrupted by recurring borewell failure and slow maintenance response in a rural Latehar cluster.
reviewedRootCauses: Delayed fault reporting during weak connectivity
successCriteria: Maintain minimum daily water availability during summer

challenges.title: Solar-assisted drinking-water reliability pilot
challenges.description: A neighbouring district piloted solar pumping with local maintenance ownership, scheduled inspection and offline-first fault logs.
challenges.aiSummary: A completed rural drinking-water reliability project combined solar pumping, local maintenance ownership and offline fault recording.

proposal.summary: Solar-assisted pump retrofit with offline maintenance log
proposal.approach: Retrofit pumps, train local operators and record faults offline for later synchronization.

milestones.title: Operate two pilot sites for eight weeks

challenges.testingOutcome: Offline logging and solar pump control remained usable during mobile network outages.
challenges.pilotNote: Eight-week pilot completed with local operator training.
challenges.deploymentNote: Handover completed to local water committee.
challenges.lessons: Local maintenance ownership and offline fault logging were essential conditions for reliable operation.

impact.evidenceNote: Pilot logbooks and community verification confirmed reduced downtime.

challenges.title: Cloud-only pump monitoring rollout
challenges.description: A previous water-monitoring project depended on continuous mobile connectivity for alerts and technician workflows.
challenges.aiSummary: A cloud-only monitoring deployment failed to remain usable during frequent network outages.

proposal.approach: Send all alerts and maintenance tickets through a cloud dashboard.

challenges.lessons: Cloud-only architecture became unusable during network outages. Future deployments require offline/local fallback and deferred synchronization.
riskRegister: Technician workflow depended on real-time cloud access

impact.evidenceNote: Field logs showed no material improvement during weak-connectivity periods.

challenges.title: District pump maintenance helpline
challenges.description: A helpline improved fault reporting but repair turnaround remained inconsistent because spare parts and local technicians were not always available.
challenges.aiSummary: A maintenance helpline improved reporting but did not fully resolve repair delays caused by parts and technician capacity.

proposal.approach: Route citizen fault reports to district maintenance teams.

challenges.lessons: Reporting improved, but the operating model also needs spare-parts inventory and named local maintenance ownership.

impact.evidenceNote: Helpline records show modest improvement but repeated delays remain.
